title: Start Date for Counting the Unused Life-of-Tread Term
content:
For a holder's cancellation of a Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate refunded on the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund, the Life-of-Tread counting date — the date from which the unused share of the term is counted — depends on the covered vehicle's fleet roster history and on the certificate's cancellation requests.

**Rule (Life-of-Tread clock start).** When the covered vehicle has an enrollment entry on a Crestline Fleet Account roster that no later removal entry has ended, the Life-of-Tread counting date is that enrollment date, the day the consumer plan stopped covering a vehicle in commercial use; when the vehicle has no such open enrollment and the certificate carries a cancellation request still awaiting the holder's confirmation, it is the date that request was registered; otherwise it is the cancellation date.

| Roster record of the vehicle | Cancellation request awaiting the holder's confirmation | Life-of-Tread counting date |
|---|---|---|
| latest enrollment entry, no later removal | any | the enrollment date |
| latest enrollment ended by a later removal, or no enrollment | yes | the date that request was registered |
| latest enrollment ended by a later removal, or no enrollment | no | the cancellation date |

**Reading the roster.** An enrollment is open when the vehicle's most recent enrollment entry has no removal entry dated after it. A removal dated before the most recent enrollment does not close that enrollment.

*Hypothetical cases.* A vehicle enrolled on a Crestline Fleet Account roster on May 4 and never removed: counting date May 4, whatever requests are on file. A vehicle enrolled February 1 and removed June 1, with a request registered August 9 still awaiting confirmation: counting date August 9.
